about_the_game:
A NSFW Fantasy Visual Novel!

Yurl carries the heavy weight of regret over his crime against the orc tribe 20 years ago.  He's settled for a life of exile, grateful his son Karn is speaking to him again.  The lascivious orc he once was is long gone, buried under tons of guilt.

Keoni is an Arch-Mage devoted to his sex god.  He partakes in regular sex rituals to please his god and increase his magic.  But these are always short trysts, one-time affairs.  He longs to have a permanent partner to share his magic with.

Can mage and orc come together to right old wrongs and find what's missing from both their lives?

NOTE:  As hard as we tried to get everything finished, a small amount of art will be black and white at launch time. Rest assured, the final color versions will be up soon! 

  •  A 1.5 to 2 Hour 15,000 Word DLC!

  • Loaded with Nine Pin-Up CGs and Additional CG Variations!

  • A New Musical Soundtrack!

  • Four Endings to Unlock!

  • Meet Six New Characters and Three New Races, including a Goblin and a sexy Centaur you get to 'ride'!

  • Guest Appearances and Scenes with Many Original Game Characters

  • Two New Game Locations/Backgrounds!

  • All Final CGs Will be in Full-Color! (We're Coloring all the Black and White CGs in the Main Game Too!)

This DLC gives us a Yurl route to the game.  Play as the Arch-Mage Keoni and make the right decisions to help both Yurl and yourself!

content_descriptors.notes: Contains explicit sex scenes.  One scene, which is optional, involves a centaur.
